comparison.objective: Safely stop a spinning centrifuge, open its lid and transfer a sample tube to a rack; candidate tunes and locks a damper for repeatable carriage stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Record tests button pressing, safe-state waiting, hinged-lid opening, tube extraction and upright rack insertion. Candidate tests recessed hex-key use, bimanual stabilization, fine collar tuning, locking torque and iterative response observation.
comparison.success_condition: Record forbids opening before rotor stop and requires stopped rotor, lid opening, tube removal and upright rack placement without moving the centrifuge or dropping the tube. Candidate requires two consecutive non-bottoming, non-overloaded, low-rebound stops with retained setting.
comparison.reason: Both include physical control actuation and machinery safety, but their central manipulation and measured capability differ: safe extraction after stopping versus mechanical tuning and retention verified through impacts. The two record spec versions are substantively identical; candidate drift tolerance remains unspecified numerically.
